_note: Written to the motors' RAM at every start and power-on, never to their flash. kp_apr: each motor's position-loop gain in position-velocity mode (DAMIAO register KP_APR; factory value 54), acc: its acceleration register. null leaves a motor's value as it is, and a value written by an earlier run stays in RAM until the motor is power-cycled, so kp_apr is given for every joint. lead_ms: how far ahead the motor loop aims each joint to cancel its lag. The DM4340 joints (J3/J4) trail by about 450 ms at the factory gain and 140 ms at 250. The shoulders (J1/J2) trail by about 145 ms, but leads near that made them overshoot up to 2x near 3 Hz, where their response has a resonance, so they use 80 ms.
